newsitem.title: USA: Ford plans put dollar/yen in 105-115 range.
newsitem.headline: Ford plans put dollar/yen in 105-115 range.

text.p: Ford Motor Co vice president David McCammon said the automaker is assuming a dollar/yen exchange rate range of 105-115 in its production and pricing plans for the next 12 months.
"That's our plan ... say 105 to 115," McCammon said on Wednesday in an interview on Reuters Financial Television.

"In the long run, this yen-dollar relationship really doesn't make sense and gives the Japanese some sort of advantage. Either they can price lower or they can make more profits. Right now they're just choosing to make more profits and in the long run, that will make them stronger and stronger. That could be a long-run problem," McCammon said.
